title: Transaction-fee and raw-event browser presentation
implementation_summary: Render gas used, effective gas price and actual fee as distinct exact integer fields using decimal-string/BigInt validation.
Render transaction value and complete raw calldata without decoded labels replacing canonical raw values.
Render complete block/transaction raw events with chain ID, block number/hash, transaction hash/index, log index, emitting address, every topic and raw data.
Use one deterministic event renderer for block and transaction views so cross-view raw-event presentation cannot drift.
Provide full-value code boxes and clipboard affordances without ellipsis or underlying-value truncation.
Fail closed in the presentation layer on malformed addresses, hashes, topics/data, unsafe integer values, fee inconsistency and transaction/receipt provenance contradiction.
Update EXP-WF-003 and EXP-WF-013 repository evidence without claiming deployed/live qualification.
required_tests: full Explorer Go regression and vet
security_findings_remediated: Browser previously summarized log topic count instead of exposing raw topic/data provenance.
Browser did not independently reject malformed raw event values before building presentation links/markup.
Transaction fee fields qualified in the API were not rendered in the browser.
Created-contract address was linked directly from API data without presentation-layer address validation.
